biography: Electrical engineer with 10+ years of experience within the power sector. I have five years of experience as a generation engineer for a generation cooperative and the rest of my career has been with a consultant where I focused on substation design. During my time as a generation engineer, I performed event reporting for the generation fleet, managed plant upgrade projects, and worked as the owners engineering for a new generation facility. As a consult engineer, I have experience with substation design from medium to high voltage, relay settings, communications settings, commissioning, and project management. I currently manage a team of 14 people comprised of both engineers and technicians that is primarily focused on protection and controls. I am proficient at team member development, resourcing, budgeting, talent planning, hiring, project scope development, client development / management, and performance tracking.
